children: Sammaan Capital’s history (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance) reflects a pattern of growth being interrupted by risk, not opportunity. The company built scale aggressively through wholesale and developer lending in its growth years.

However rising asset-quality stress and funding-access challenges through FY20–24 forced a prolonged period of balance-sheet repair, reflected in deeply negative profitability (-10.9 per cent ROA/-35.6 per cent ROE) in the base year, alongside an elevated GNPA stock requiring  ₹6,499 crore exceptional impairment to clean up the book.

The turning point came with IHC’s strategic intervention: a two-tranche ₹8,850 crore capital infusion securing a 43.5 per cent controlling stake, which triggered AA+ rating upgrades from Crisil, CARE, and ICRA, and unlocked access to lower-cost borrowings.

Sammaan Capital has moved past its distressed phase into what we view as an early-stage re-rating opportunity, where strengthening profitability, IHC-led capital and governance support and improving asset quality together underpin the investment case.
We initiate coverage with a BUY rating and a price target of ₹377.7 (2.0x FY29E P/ABV) over the next 24 months.
Key risks: Rapid retail/MSME-LAP scale-up without matching underwriting discipline risks seasoning-led delinquencies, impacting GNPA and credit costs.

title: Broker’s call: Sammaan Capital (Buy)
